title: Touhou Kouryuudou ~ Unconnected Marketeers - The Princess Who Slays Dragon Kings
description:
Momoyo Himemushi's theme from the 18th Touhou game, Unconnected Marketeers.

This song starts with chromatic buildup sections, before switching over to the happy and pumped-up chorus. I find it funny how similar some of the Retrologue instruments sound to SMW ones. Thank you @1.

Probably my favourite Touhou extra boss theme.
